name: Letta
summary: Letta (formerly MemGPT) builds stateful agents whose memory persists across sessions and models. Since March 2026 its focus is Letta Code, a model-agnostic agent harness, with memory stored as a git-backed filesystem of Markdown files (MemFS) that agents edit with ordinary file tools.
facts: Git-backed Markdown files (MemFS), versioned per agent
Letta Cloud or self-hosted app server
Free; Pro $20/mo; API plan $20/mo plus usage
goodFor: Long-lived agents that keep identity across models
Memory with git history and diffs
Coding agents that learn a codebase over time
watchOut: March 2026 pivot deprecated older server-side memory tools, templates and filesystem
Older tutorials describe memory blocks and APIs that no longer apply
